intent: Finish the sixteen older foe concepts and replace eleven older inventory icons whose meaning was unclear at card or relic size.
foe_method: Each earlier game/assets/foes/<id>.png supplied identity; a finished Kiln Warden or Fork Bomb sprite supplied crisp linework, cel shading and left-facing battle pose. Transparent full-body cutouts retain each concept's color and defining feature.
hydra_parts: The shared body has three exposed two-pin cable ends; the separate head has a recessed two-hole rear socket. The head edit received a second transparency cleanup to remove an unwanted halo.
icon_reference: game/assets/shardrun/card-fire-constant.png supplies bronze, jewel and chunky pixel-art materials. Each object is isolated on alpha and designed for 32 px display.

icons.relic-amortized-ledger: open ledger showing a large charge reduced to a single coin
icons.relic-big-o-compass: large brass compass pointing away from a crossed-out loop
icons.relic-blood-engine: black iron turbine powered by one vivid blood droplet
icons.relic-radix-sort: three ordered gemstone beads on an abacus
icons.relic-unix-philosophy: single precision chisel making one bright mark
icons.shard-apex: one peak crystal above discarded small shards
icons.shard-echo: two identical bolts linked by a violet echo ring
icons.shard-glass-cannon: crystal cannon firing as its glass shield breaks
icons.shard-lazy-fork: forked crystal with one chipped branch
icons.shard-singularity: three bolts collapsing into a high-contrast dark vortex
icons.shard-tithe: balance scale trading one large crystal for two smaller ones
